Path and route name match paas_manager's existing CupertinoRoute(path: '/main', page: MainRoute.page), so host navigation call-sites keep working when the host deletes its own copy of the page.

Sync-issues screen (park-and-surface): parked needs_attention records across the three manager boxes with per-record Retry/Discard. New path, no legacy paas_manager counterpart; route name follows the Manager prefix convention. Reached from the restaurant tab's sections list.

integrations._comment: Pairs with auth_sdk >= 1.9.0's @auth-entry-config placeholder (Users repo). Ray's rule: Skip (guest entry) lives in the shared login page and shows in ALL apps by default; a home SDK that doesn't need it opts out — 'delivery and merchants dont need it'. On older auth_sdk the marker is absent and the installer only warns (wiring NOT applied), leaving behavior unchanged.

routes._comment: Route names carry a Manager prefix (revenue_sdk's ManagerIncomeRoute convention) but keep paas_manager's exact legacy paths and CupertinoRoute/MaterialRoute types, so host navigation call-sites swap class names only. merchants_sdk's main_page.dart FAB pushes ManagerCreateOrderRoute - that name is this manifest's contract. The installed pages carry @RoutePage(name: 'Manager...Route'), so auto_route generates the classes in the host's own app_router.gr.dart.

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled Afrikaans map for its manifest tr_keys into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot. Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Requires a base_sdk with bundled_translations.dart.

routes._comment: The installed page carries @RoutePage() with the NotificationListPage class name, so auto_route generates NotificationListRoute in the host's own app_router.gr.dart. Path and route name match paas_manager's existing hand-written CupertinoRoute(path: '/list-notification', page: NotificationListRoute.page), so the composed restaurant tab's context.pushRoute(const NotificationListRoute()) keeps working when the host deletes its own copy of the page and drops the hand-written route.

boot_hooks._comment: Windows notification delivery, POS parity (1.6.0): firebase_messaging has no Windows implementation, so the FCM hook above deliberately excludes Windows and composed Windows exes shipped with NO notification path at all. This hook starts comms' DesktopNotificationPoller (10s REST count polling + looping POS notification.wav + ValueNotifier badge feed - see the service's doc comment) on Windows only. The start is deferred to addPostFrameCallback because boot-hook bodies run BEFORE LocalStorage.init() and the sdk-di block in the generated main.dart: by first frame both are done, and runApp is never delayed by a poll. Fail-open try/catch like the FCM hook - a boot failure debugPrints instead of blanking the app. WidgetsBinding resolves via main.dart's static material import; foundation dedupes with the FCM hook's wiring import. Toast layer (still 1.6.0, same unmerged PR): poller.start() also initializes LocalNotifications fail-open (flutter_local_notifications 19.x WindowsInitializationSettings - stable hardcoded GUID, APP_NAME/WINDOWS_AUMID dart-defines for branding, works unpackaged; MSIX identity optional host-side) and each count increase raises a native toast via LocalNotifications.show() alongside the sound - no hook body change needed, the toast path lives entirely inside the service.

embedded_widgets._comment: Header slot (ADR-005): shells embed the compact adaptive widget without importing weather_sdk directly. inlineExpansion=false because headers are height-constrained; on small screens that leaves just the minimal icon+temp chip, and the popup-free WeatherInlineForecast card is placed in body flow via the weather_sdk barrel (it takes a WeatherState argument, so it cannot ride the zero-arg embedded-widget seam).

Severe-weather heads-up banner (zero-arg seam, ADR-005): hosts place it in body flow; it renders SizedBox.shrink() whenever there are no active warnings, the warnings cmd fails, or the composed backend does not expose tenant.api.get_weather_warnings yet - so embedding it is always safe, in any merge order with the backend rollout. Location comes from the same WeatherSdkConfig.locationResolver the header widget's install template wires.

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled Afrikaans map for its manifest tr_keys into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot. Top-level (not app_type-gated) because translations are role-agnostic. Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Requires a base_sdk with bundled_translations.dart.

routes._comment: CupertinoRoute matches the legacy paas_manager app_router entry for this page (driver's flavour of the same path is a MaterialRoute). Declaring this block also keeps lib/src/manager/ alive through the composer's role-stripping.

boot_hooks._comment: Order 30: after comms' Firebase/FCM boot (10) and its desktop notification poller (20) - order 20 is already taken and duplicate orders draw a composer warning. Android-only and fail-open like comms' hooks. The initialize() call itself is a strict no-op unless DeviceServices proves the device GMS-free AND HMS-capable, so GMS devices and detection errors keep comms_sdk's FCM path as the sole push owner. The await is cheap: initialize() only awaits the availability probe and turnOnPush - the push token arrives asynchronously on Push Kit's token stream, so runApp is never delayed by a token round-trip.
